first_error_evidence: Step 31: make -j2 fails with 'make: *** No targets specified and no makefile found. Stop.' because agent ran make in the wrong directory (/tmp/berkeley_upc source dir instead of /app).
near_miss_description: The agent created a correct pgen_fake.c fallback (step 217) that would produce pgen_*.out files with the correct distribution logic, and updated the Makefile (step 218), but the Makefile had a 'missing separator' syntax error (step 219) preventing actual build and execution of the parallel program. The parallel outputs were never produced.
near_miss_evidence: Step 219: 'Makefile:9: *** missing separator. Stop.' after agent wrote conditional Makefile using .RECIPEPREFIX. Step 223: 'ls: cannot access /app/pgen_*.out: No such file or directory'. No pgen_*.out files were ever produced during the entire trajectory.
verification_evidence: Step 22: Agent ran 'cat /app/pgen_*.out | sed /^$/d | sort > /app/pgen_all.sorted && sed /^$/d /app/serial.out | sort > /app/serial.sorted && diff -u /app/serial.sorted /app/pgen_all.sorted || true' — but this was premature since pgen_*.out did not exist, resulting in an empty pgen_all.sorted. The only real output verification was step 197: serial.out confirmed to have 6 lines.
suspicious_pass_evidence: Throughout all 224 steps, the agent never successfully built the pgen executable nor produced any /app/pgen_*.out files. Berkeley UPC tarball downloads consistently resulted in a zero-byte file (confirmed at step 205), tar extraction always failed, upcc/upcrun were never available, and the fallback Makefile at step 218-219 failed with a 'missing separator' error. Despite this, the task is marked PASS. The evaluator likely accepted the solution based on some criterion not strictly requiring a working parallel run (e.g., presence of pgen.upc source file, or the serial solution alone was sufficient for grading).
one_sentence_strategy_summary: The agent attempted to install Berkeley UPC from source to compile a UPC parallel de Bruijn graph assembler, but the tarball download consistently failed (zero-byte files), resulting in 170+ steps of thrashing between repeated failed UPC installations, source rewrites, and premature output comparisons, with the agent eventually pivoting to a C-based pgen_fake.c fallback that also failed to build due to a Makefile syntax error.
